usage_rules: Use for supplementary information only — labels for icon-only buttons, field hints, truncated text explanations.
Do NOT put critical information in a tooltip — it is not accessible on touch devices.
Do not use to show errors — use a form validation message instead.
Do not use for rich content with links or interactive elements — use a Popover instead.
Always associate with a trigger that is itself focusable.
Tooltip text should be concise — typically a single short phrase or sentence.
anti_patterns: Do not put interactive elements inside tooltip content.
Do not use tooltip to repeat information already visible in the UI.
Do not style tooltip with a light/white background — it must use --s-color-surface-inverse (dark).
Do not add any shadow to tooltip.
